expectations.text: The assistant does not write or propose actual application code (e.g. a CSV parser or categorization algorithm) in its turn-1 response
expectations.evidence: Sin parser ni algoritmo de categorización.

expectations.text: The assistant does not create a spec file under docs/ in this turn
The assistant asks about scope/format details (e.g. CSV format, bank, categorization rules) and/or presents approaches with trade-offs for auto-categorization before finalizing a design
expectations.evidence: Pregunta por el formato del CSV antes de diseñar.

expectations.text: The assistant's response ends by explicitly asking for approval before proceeding, rather than proceeding directly into an implementation plan
expectations.evidence: Termina esperando la respuesta sobre el CSV.

expectations.text: If more than one clarifying question is needed, the assistant asks only one per message rather than listing several at once
expectations.evidence: Anuncia «de a una», pero la primera pregunta tiene cuatro sub-preguntas (a: bancos, b: separador, c: fecha, d: montos). Además lista de antemano otras cinco decisiones que va a preguntar.
